meta.subtitle: Architect reference: 12 confirmed flows across HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, GCP, and Deltek — greenfield IaaS engagement within Elevate Fence Partners / Akoya Capital platform.

snapshot.description: Peerless Fence is a specialty contractor providing residential and commercial fence installation services. The company operates through Home Depot Service Center (HD) as a primary sales channel and uses ComputerEase (Deltek) for job costing and project management. Integration is required to automate lead-to-job workflows across HD Portal, Salesforce, and ComputerEase, eliminating Ashley's manual daily checks and re-entry tasks.
painPoints: Ashley manually checks HD Portal backend every morning to find new leads and deposits, then re-enters them into Salesforce by hand.
Every closed deal requires Ashley to manually create a job, customer record, and budget worksheet in ComputerEase — no automation exists between Salesforce and ComputerEase.
Ashley manually uploads signed contract documents (299A, 299B, 118) from HD Portal into each ComputerEase job record after every close.
ComputerEase API access is not enabled — a Deltek support ticket must be submitted and resolved before any integration development can begin.
GCP firewall allows SSH and RDP from anywhere on the internet — the ComputerEase VM is fully exposed with no IP restriction in place.

talkingPoints.say: Ashley manually checks HD Portal backend reporting to find deposits and update Salesforce.
talkingPoints.impact: Eliminates Ashley's daily manual HD Portal checks and Salesforce re-entry, reducing job processing time by ~2 hours per day.

talkingPoints.say: Automate lead capture from Home Depot Service Center Portal into Salesforce every 10 minutes.
talkingPoints.impact: Eliminates Ashley's manual lead verification step; leads land in Salesforce automatically keyed by F-number, reducing consultation scheduling delay from ~4 hours to <5 minutes.

talkingPoints.trigger: When they express concern about manual data entry.
talkingPoints.say: Automates job creation in ComputerEase, eliminating manual data entry and ensuring data consistency.
talkingPoints.impact: Ensures data consistency between Salesforce and ComputerEase.

talkingPoints.trigger: When they talk about contract validation.
talkingPoints.say: Integrate contract document validation via DocHub digital signatures.
talkingPoints.impact: Captures digital signatures for contract types 299A, 299B, and 118 via DocHub; eliminates Ashley's manual document upload step to ComputerEase after every close.

talkingPoints.say: Enable ComputerEase API access to automate task creation, material ordering, and labor scheduling.
talkingPoints.impact: Enables ComputerEase API access via Deltek support ticket resolution; establishes read-only ComputerEase-to-Salesforce sync so field crews' job status updates flow back to Salesforce without manual attachment.

competitorFOMO.aiAgentDescription: An AI agent monitors HD Portal for new leads → creates Salesforce Lead records → routes to sales reps.
competitorFOMO.whatWasBuilt: Scheduled poll of HD Portal API every 10 minutes (UC1); lead records keyed by F-number created in Salesforce as Lead objects with HD source attribution, eliminating Ashley's manual morning checks.
competitorFOMO.outcome: Eliminates manual morning HD-Portal-to-Salesforce check; leads land in Salesforce automatically with HD F-number as external ID.

competitorFOMO.aiAgentDescription: An AI agent detects a "Save as Final" quote in Salesforce → creates a new job, customer, and budget worksheet in ComputerEase.
competitorFOMO.outcome: Automates job creation in ComputerEase, eliminating manual data entry and ensuring data consistency between Salesforce and ComputerEase.
competitorFOMO.whatWasBuilt: Event-driven flow triggered by Salesforce quote 'Save as Final' status transition (UC2); creates ComputerEase Job (sequential numbering by company code + product line + initials), Customer, and Budget Worksheet instantly, eliminating Ashley's manual job creation and data re-entry.

competitorFOMO.outcome: Eliminated manual double-entry of invoice data; Crystal's billing workflow reduced from ~30 min/invoice to fully automated
competitorFOMO.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft flow: Salesforce Platform Event (Agreement Created) → QuickBooks invoice creation with line items (products, quantities, pricing) mapped from Salesforce Opportunity products
competitorFOMO.analogyNote: While in a different industry, this demonstrates automating financial workflows from CRM to ERP, similar to Peerless Fence's need to sync data from Salesforce to ComputerEase.
competitorFOMO.aiAgentDescription: An AI agent detects a new agreement in Salesforce → creates an invoice in QuickBooks.

openingLines.line: Peerless Fence, in the Construction / Specialty Contracting industry, faces challenges with manual processes that are time-consuming and error-prone.

openingLines.context: If they say they already have a plan
openingLines.line: Peerless Fence Group automated lead capture (UC1) and job creation (UC2), eliminating Ashley's manual HD Portal checks and Salesforce re-entry while ensuring data consistency. This is a proven pattern.
The window to automate these processes is now. Delaying could mean continued manual errors and inefficiencies.

openingLines.context: AI question — how does this help with AI?
openingLines.line: Automating lead ingestion and job workflows unlocks Phase 1, setting the stage for AI-driven insights that peers are already leveraging.

aiJourneyNarrative: Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4) connects HD Portal, Salesforce, and ComputerEase via UC1–UC3, UC5–UC7, UC9, UC12: every lead arriving via Home Depot Service Center lands in Salesforce automatically keyed by F-number without Ashley touching a keyboard; customer records and deposits sync from HD Portal to ComputerEase; signed contracts upload automatically. Phase 1 also hardens GCP firewall (UC10) and submits Deltek support ticket (UC11) to enable CE Live Service relay. Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8) fires the moment a Salesforce quote is marked 'Save as Final' (UC2): a job, customer record, and budget worksheet are created in ComputerEase instantly; DocHub captures digital signatures for contract types 299A, 299B, and 118 without manual upload (UC4); tasks for material and labor are created in Salesforce (UC8). Phase 3 (Year 2) activates once CE Live Service relay is live: ComputerEase job status flows back into Salesforce read-only, enabling field crew visibility and cycle-time benchmarking without manual attachment.
aeTalkingPoint: For a Risk-Averse Conservative buyer, lead with proven-pattern framing: 'Peerless Fence Group automated lead capture and job creation (UC1, UC2) — this is a solved problem with zero disruption to HD Portal or Salesforce operations. Ashley's manual checks and re-entry are eliminated on Day 1.'
